messages.subject: dBref
parts:
Hi everybody,
I am trying to use meanspec to obtain the spectrum out of a WAV file. I am interested in the dB(A) as an output and having some trouble to capture the results that a collaborator got with a different software. My first concern is the suggestion of using 2*10E-5 as a reference value, equivalent to 20 microPascal. I would think that the right value is 2E-5, which is 10 times smaller than the suggested value. Is there a reason for this, that I am not understanding?

Thanks a lot!

Cristina

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] dBref
parts:
Dear Cristina,
Your right, the documentation of meanspec() is confusing. I will replace 2*10e-5 in a next version by 2.10^-5 (=2*e-5).
Thank you for pointing out to this mistake,
Best regards,
Jerome
